First one was good, if somewhat unpolished. Loved the atmosphere and the pacing though.

Then along comes Dead Space 3. I was excited to play this game, but unfortunately that excitement quickly disappeared.

  • Turning a major character from the previous game into a dumbass with Lara Croft sized boobs.

  • Having said character's new flame be one of the most stereotypically punchable douchecanoes in history.

  • A horribly cookie-cutter villain (seriously, I love Simon Templeman as a voice artist, but Danik is a terrible villain).

  • The plot goes completely off the rails and doesn't know what it wants to be (goes from action, to space horror for a shamefully brief amount of time, then turns into "The Thing....In Space!" once you get planetside).

  • Shoehorned, tacked-on multiplayer with dialog showing up in SP that shouldn't. I firmly believe the rest of the game sucking so much ass is partly because they wasted time and resources trying to cram multiplayer into a series that doesn't fucking need it.

  • A resource system that's horribly dumbed-down.

  • Re-using gimmicks from the previous titles (the unkillable monster chasing you).

  • GODDAMN MICROTRANSACTIONS.

  • Way more "press X to not die" parts than the first two COMBINED.

  • Just an overall feeling of "meh".

Basically, EA took the good thing that Visceral had going, and managed to completely ruin it.
